local_review_questions.finding: Each StartFindService iteration constructs a callback capturing a different index. Multiple successful registrations do not exercise repeated calls with identical callback arguments or establish unchanged discovery state.
local_review_questions.proposed_follow_up: Review the native operation/registration contract, repeat the same callback and specifier, and compare relevant observable discovery state. Keep valid returned handles for cleanup; do not invent a handle-equality requirement.

local_review_questions.finding: Availability is checked after two OfferService calls and after two StopOfferService calls, without before/after comparisons around the duplicate call. Duplicate discovery entries or a stop effective only on the second call would not be excluded by those checks.
local_review_questions.proposed_follow_up: Check service availability and relevant discovered-handle cardinality after the first offer and after the repeated offer; wait for absence after the first stop, then assert absence after the repeated stop. Use native supported observations and finite deadlines.
